originalTitle: 5 Best High Growth Stocks Outside Big Tech

content:
The market's growth leadership has become abnormally concentrated in a small number of mega-cap technology stocks, leaving investors with fewer obvious opportunities to find rapid earnings growth outside of the AI trade. Ten AI-related stocks currently account for over 40% of the S&P 500's market capitalization, with NVDA, AAPL, and MSFT accounting for approximately 21.7% of the index. That concentration has made non-tech growth stocks more appealing, but also more selective: a company can generate strong revenue growth while struggling to justify its valuation if margins, debt, customer concentration, or capital intensity are all trending in the wrong direction. The opportunity comes from identifying businesses with long-term growth that can support multiples rather than merely riding the broader AI story, something we previously covered in our 10 High Growth Stocks Outside Tech Analysts Are Bullish On article.

The case for looking beyond mega-cap technology is that large tech companies haven't stopped growing. Their valuations already account for much of the predicted AI-driven earnings acceleration, while a number of healthcare, industrial, consumer, finance, and energy companies are growing at rates that may surprise investors.

According to Russell Investments, analysts anticipate the "Magnificent Seven" to increase third-quarter earnings by 20.3% year over year, while the other 493 companies in the S&P 500 are expected to grow by 27.7%. In other words, earnings momentum is broadening beyond the largest tech firms, potentially offering up opportunities for companies outside the AI trade.

The idea is to avoid using "growth" as a single metric. A company that grows revenue at 30% per year could still be a bad investment if it burns cash, relies on a small number of customers, or funds expansion through repeated dilution. Netskope is a good example : the cybersecurity company announced second-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $220.5 million, up 29.2% year-over-year, but trailing EBITDA remained negative at $721 million, and the stock traded at about 9x sales. That is, investors are paying a premium for ongoing top-line momentum as they wait for more proof that growth can translate into durable profits. In contrast, a company growing earnings in the high teens or low twenties can be appealing if it has pricing power, recurring revenue, a strong balance sheet, and a clear path to margin improvement.

The issue is that some companies have already been rerated as "AI adjacent," even though their underlying earnings haven't yet justified the premium. That's why the best opportunities are typically identified where growth is still undervalued, rather than where the AI label has already done the majority of the work.

The sector has expanded beyond construction, mining and machinery cycles to include companies that benefit from data-center power needs, grid modernization, automation and infrastructure spending. Caterpillar, for example, reported record second quarter sales of $20.5 billion , up 24% year-over-year, with its Power Generation division up 29% to $3.10 billion on demand for large reciprocating engines and turbines used in data centers. Despite AI taking up a lot of the news in the market, Mario Gabelli's fund has an industrial stock in its second biggest position , highlighting the idea that there can be interesting growth opportunities outside of the tech industry.

Analyst estimates can help identify expectations, but they should not be used in place of company-specific evidence. A stock with a high consensus growth rate and a high valuation may be more exposed to a modest guidance miss than a cheaper company with a less exciting but more consistent growth profile.

So, what are the best high growth stocks outside big tech? We listed 10 Best High Growth Stocks Outside Big Tech here . You can find the top 5 below.

For this list, we screened for non-tech stocks with a market cap of more than $20 billion that report a 5-year EPS growth rate of at least 25%. We have also mentioned hedge fund ownership numbers for Q2 2026 to provide insight into smart money sentiments around each stock.

Note : A 5-year EPS growth rate is useful for comparing how quickly earnings are expected to compound, though it is not always the most reliable metric as estimates can change sharply with commodity prices, interest rates, clinical trial results, and other macroeconomic conditions.

EPS Growth Over the Next 5 Years: 46.62%

Vale S.A. is one of the world's top iron ore producers, and is growing into copper and nickel through Vale Base Metals. In the second quarter, iron ore production reached 84.3 million tons, the highest since 2018, with copper recording its best second quarter in nine years. Base metals EBITDA increased 79% to $1.29 billion, accounting for three out of every ten dollars of segment EBITDA, while iron ore contributed $3.06 billion. Moreover, in October, Vale sought to establish a Panda bond program in China worth up to 10 billion yuan, which provided roughly half of second-quarter revenue.

That dependence is also a risk. Back in August, Chinese crude steel output declined 3.7% from the previous year, and iron ore prices followed suit. Iron ore costs also rose with the stronger Brazilian real. See how Vale is strengthening its relations with China, including a potential yuan bond .

EPS Growth Over the Next 5 Years: 48.40%

Phillips 66 operates refineries, midstream pipelines, chemicals, and marketing operations. By mid-September, its shares had risen more than 110% for the year, as the Middle East war reduced global refining capacity and increased margins. The company's third-quarter results, released on October 28, showed how powerful that backdrop had become: adjusted earnings increased to $5.6 billion, or $14.08 per share, from $3.8 billion, or $9.41 per share, in the second quarter.

Revenue and cash generation also improved. Total revenues and other income reached $51.5 billion
chineseTitle: 大型科技公司之外的 5 只最佳高增长股票
chineseSummary: 市场的增长领先地位已异常集中于少数大型科技股，这使得投资者在人工智能行业之外寻找快速盈利增长的明显机会越来越少。目前，十只人工智能相关股票占标准普尔 500 指数市值的 40% 以上，其中 NVDA、AAPL 和 MSFT 约占 21.7% […]
chineseContent:
市场的增长领先地位已异常集中于少数大型科技股，这使得投资者在人工智能行业之外寻找快速盈利增长的明显机会越来越少。目前，10只人工智能相关股票占标准普尔500指数市值的40%以上，其中NVDA、AAPL和MSFT约占该指数的21.7%。这种集中度使非科技成长型股票更具吸引力，但也更具选择性：如果利润率、债务、客户集中度或资本密集度都朝着错误的方向发展，一家公司可以实现强劲的收入增长，同时难以证明其估值合理。机会来自于识别具有长期增长能力、能够支持市盈率的企业，而不是仅仅利用更广泛的人工智能故事，我们之前在科技分析师看好的 10 只高增长股票一文中对此进行了介绍。

超越大型科技公司的理由是，大型科技公司并未停止增长。它们的估值已经在很大程度上解释了人工智能驱动的盈利加速预测，而许多医疗保健、工业、消费、金融和能源公司的增长速度可能会让投资者感到惊讶。

罗素投资公司表示，分析师预计“七巨头”第三季度盈利将同比增长20.3%，而标准普尔500指数中的其他493家公司预计将增长27.7%。换句话说，盈利势头正在扩大到最大的科技公司之外，这可能为人工智能行业以外的公司提供机会。

这个想法是避免使用“增长”作为单一指标。一家年收入增长 30% 的公司，如果烧钱、依赖少数客户，或者通过反复稀释来扩大资金规模，那么它仍然可能是一项糟糕的投资。 Netskope 就是一个很好的例子：这家网络安全公司宣布 2027 财年第二季度收入为 2.205 亿美元，同比增长 29.2%，但往绩 EBITDA 仍为负值，为 7.21 亿美元，而该股的交易价格约为销售额的 9 倍。也就是说，投资者正在为持续的营收势头支付溢价，因为他们等待更多证据证明增长可以转化为持久利润。相比之下，如果一家公司拥有定价能力、经常性收入、强劲的资产负债表以及明确的利润改善路径，那么其盈利增长在十几岁或二十岁以下的公司可能会很有吸引力。

问题在于，一些公司已经被重新评级为“人工智能邻近”，尽管它们的基本盈利尚未证明溢价合理。这就是为什么最好的机会通常是在增长仍被低估的地方发现的，而不是在人工智能标签已经完成大部分工作的地方。

该行业已从建筑、采矿和机械周期扩展到包括受益于数据中心电力需求、电网现代化、自动化和基础设施支出的公司。例如，卡特彼勒报告称，第二季度销售额达到创纪录的 205 亿美元，同比增长 24%，其发电部门增长 29%，达到 31 亿美元，以满足数据中心使用的大型往复式发动机和涡轮机的需求。尽管人工智能占据了市场上的很多新闻，但马里奥·加贝利（Mario Gabelli）的基金仍将工业股票列为第二大头寸，这突显了科技行业之外可能存在有趣的增长机会的想法。

分析师的估计可以帮助确定预期，但不应用来代替公司特定的证据。与增长状况不那么令人兴奋但更稳定的廉价公司相比，具有高共识增长率和高估值的股票可能更容易受到适度指导偏差的影响。

那么，除了大型科技公司之外，最好的高增长股票是什么？我们在此列出了大型科技公司之外的 10 只最佳高增长股票。您可以在下面找到前 5 名。

在这份榜单中，我们筛选了市值超过 200 亿美元、且 5 年每股收益增长率至少为 25% 的非科技股。我们还提到了 2026 年第二季度的对冲基金所有权数据，以深入了解每只股票的精明资金情绪。

注：5 年每股收益增长率有助于比较预期收益复合的速度，但它并不总是最可靠的指标，因为估计值可能会随着商品价格、利率、临床试验结果和其他宏观经济条件而发生急剧变化。

未来5年每股收益增长：46.62%

淡水河谷公司是世界顶级铁矿石生产商之一，并通过淡水河谷基本金属公司发展铜和镍业务。第二季度铁矿石产量达到8430万吨，创2018年以来最高水平，铜矿第二季度产量创九年来最佳表现。基本金属 EBITDA 增长 79%，达到 12.9 亿美元，占该部门 EBITDA 的十分之三，而铁矿石贡献了 30.6 亿美元。此外，10月，淡水河谷寻求在中国建立价值高达100亿元人民币的熊猫债券计划，约占第二季度收入的一半。

这种依赖也是一种风险。 8月份，中国粗钢产量同比下降3.7%，铁矿石价格也随之下降。随着巴西雷亚尔走强，铁矿石成本也上涨。了解淡水河谷如何加强与中国的关系，包括潜在的人民币债券。

未来5年每股收益增长：48.40%

Phillips 66 经营炼油厂、中游管道、化学品和营销业务。截至9月中旬，由于中东战争减少了全球炼油产能并提高了利润率，该公司股价年内上涨超过110%。该公司于 10 月 28 日发布的第三季度业绩显示了这一背景的强大：调整后收益从第二季度的 38 亿美元（即每股 9.41 美元）增至 56 亿美元（即每股 14.08 美元）。

收入和现金产生也有所改善。总收入和其他收入达到 515 亿美元
